countries.adjudication: Item codes agreed (100), but the coders rested I3 on different bodies. Coder A accepted the Chamber of Deputies CEDES (Resolucao 26/2013) under the legislature technology-assessment clause and rejected Ipea as a think tank; coder B did the reverse. Adjudicated with B: CEDES art. 2 II (read by the adjudicator) mandates feasibility and impact studies of technologies, plans and policies, with no long-term or emerging-change wording, so condition 3 fails; Ipea is a federal public foundation (condition 1) whose statute, Decreto 11.194 of 8 Sep 2022, art. 3 III, names medium and long-term prospective studies (condition 3), and it operated after the 1 Jan 2023 change (condition met for I3). The MPO long-term planning undersecretariat (Decreto 11.353, art. 16) carries I1 and I2. SAE closed 1 Jan 2023 with the prospective mandate moved to MPO the same day, so I4 is 0. Score 100.
